Money is an abstract representation of value. For it to work, it has to be scarce and people have to agree on it's value. In that sense bitcoin is just as fake as any other currency.

Also bitcoin has yet to be tested through a serious crisis, think, Lehman like crisis, or bank run crisis.

  • Backups, easy to store
